title: Kummer etale G-covers and their fs base-change diagrams
statement: Let $C,D$ be locally Noetherian fs log schemes, with log morphisms as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and let $G$ be a finite group acting on $C$ as in [def-per-fs-log-group-action]. A log morphism $q:C\to D$ is a Kummer etale $G$-cover if it is log etale [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale], Kummer [def-per-kummer-log-morphism], finite and surjective on underlying schemes, and $q a_g=q$ as log morphisms for all $g\in G$. Its canonical diagonal $\coprod_{g\in G}C\to C\times_D^{\rm fs}C$, with component $(1,a_g)$, is required to be an isomorphism. Equivalently, there are an fs log scheme $S$, strict component inclusions $\iota_g:C\to S$ exhibiting the underlying scheme as a coproduct [def-galois-finite-coproduct], and log maps $l,r:S\to C$ with $l\iota_g=1_C$, $r\iota_g=a_g$, such that $(S,l,r)$ is the fs pullback of $(q,q)$ in the universal-property sense of [def-per-fs-log-pullback]. Strictness fixes the component log structures. A locally Noetherian fs base-change diagram for $q$ consists of fs log schemes $E,C_E$, maps $f:E\to D$, $p:C_E\to C$, $q_E:C_E\to E$, and this same fs pullback universal property. Its action $b$ is induced from $a$ when $p b_g=a_g p$ and $q_E b_g=q_E$ as log morphisms for every $g$. A comparison from a second diagram $(E',C_{E'},f',p',q_{E'})$ over a log map $h:E'\to E$ is a log map $r:C_{E'}\to C_E$ with $p r=p'$ and $q_E r=h q_{E'}$. Identities are the actual log morphisms of [def-per-log-morphism-identity]. Compositions are the restriction to fs endpoints of the relative-section construction of [def-per-log-morphism-composition], including their section maps. Strictness and identity predicates are as in [def-per-strict-log-morphism]. Mutually inverse comparison maps mean inverse full log morphisms as in [def-per-inverse-log-morphisms].

source.place: VI 2.1--2.3, printed pp.71--73; X 1.8, printed pp.146--147, diagram (1.a).
